items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: And I had a little African, little African boy, his name was Baccuse (PHONETIC)

ctx.x: And I had a little African, little African boy, his name was Baccuse (PHONETIC), and he -- well, Africans and me, we get along, got along very well together. So he's a waiter, and he was a busy little fellow, he could do anything. So -- and he could count as fast -- with a slight bit of education this boy could calculate so fast, just exactly like a computer. And she was saying, no, no, you've got so and so all this time. And she had stolen half of the ribbon off the typewriter. He said, no, you see what's been…
I've got a picture there, someone took the picture, and I'm looking at her, and he's doing that. So she said,
